__comment: SLO Overview dashboard (OR-009 / OR-019, per {SAD:ADR-0009} + specs/dod.md SLI/SLO table). Panels read the canonical SLIs precomputed by observability/prometheus/recording-rules.yml. The validate-latency panel is intentionally a 'pending E013' note: the online validate/heartbeat handler ships in E013 (IP-003), so no validate SLI series exist yet. Versioned in-repo (AD-006) so the dashboard ships with the release and is reviewable.
title: License API - SLO Overview

panels.title: Availability (SLO 99.9%)
panels.description: Fraction of requests that did not server-error over a 30d rolling window (job:request_availability:ratio_rate30d).

panels.title: Activation Success (SLO >= 99.9%)
panels.description: Successful activations / (successes + server errors) over 30d, EXCLUDING policy denials (job:activation_success:ratio_rate30d).

panels.title: Issuance Latency p95 (SLO < 300 ms)
panels.description: p95 duration for POST /admin/licenses over 5m (job:issuance_latency:p95_5m). Threshold line at 300 ms.

panels.title: Validate Latency p95 / p99 (pending E013)
panels.description: Placeholder for the validate/heartbeat latency SLI (SLO p95 < 120 ms).

options.content:
### Validate Latency SLI - pending E013

The online **validate / heartbeat** handler ships in **E013** (IP-003). Until then no `http_request_duration_seconds{route="/v1/validate"}` series exist, so this SLI shows **no data**.

The recording rules (`job:validate_latency:p95_5m` / `p99_5m`) are already defined but **commented out** in `observability/prometheus/recording-rules.yml`; E013 enables them by uncommenting, and this panel is replaced with a live timeseries (SLO target **p95 < 120 ms**).

panels.title: Error Budget Remaining (30d, 99.9% target)
panels.description: Remaining availability error budget over 30d: 1 - (1 - availability) / (1 - 0.999).
